SELECT DISTINCT 
    a.nome AS nome_aeroporto_destinazione,
    a.citta AS citta_destinazione,
    a.iata AS codice_destinazione
FROM rotta r
JOIN aeroporto a ON r.iata_arrivo = a.iata
WHERE r.iata_partenza IN (
    SELECT iata FROM aeroporto WHERE continente = 'OC'
)
ORDER BY nome_aeroporto_destinazione

SELECT 
    a_dest.nome,
    a_dest.citta,
    a_dest.iata
FROM DBVOLI.aeroporto AS a_dest
INNER JOIN DBVOLI.rotta AS r ON a_dest.iata = r.iata_arrivo
INNER JOIN DBVOLI.aeroporto AS a_partenza ON r.iata_partenza = a_partenza.iata
WHERE a_partenza.continente = 'OC'
ORDER BY a_dest.nome, a_dest.citta

SELECT DISTINCT a.nome, a.citta, a.iata
FROM DBVOLI.aeroporto a
JOIN DBVOLI.rotta r ON a.iata = r.iata_arrivo
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM DBVOLI.aeroporto a_origine 
    WHERE a_origine.continente = 'OC' 
    AND a_origine.iata = r.iata_partenza
)

SELECT DISTINCT r.iata_arrivo, aeroporto.nome, aeroporto.citta
FROM DBVOLI.rotta r
INNER JOIN DBVOLI.aeroporto a_partenza ON r.iata_partenza = a_partenza.iata
INNER JOIN DBVOLI.aeroporto aeroporto ON r.iata_arrivo = aeroporto.iata
WHERE a_partenza.continente = 'OC'

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) AS costo_medio 
FROM camera c 
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome 
GROUP BY h.citta 
ORDER BY costo_medio ASC 
LIMIT 1
SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as costo_medio FROM camera c JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome GROUP BY h.citta ORDER BY costo_medio ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) AS prezzo_medio 
FROM camera c
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome
GROUP BY h.citta
ORDER BY prezzo_medio ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as prezzo_medio
FROM DBHOTEL.camera c
JOIN DBHOTEL.hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome
GROUP BY h.citta

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) AS num_voli 
FROM volo v 
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id 
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800' 
GROUP BY r.compagnia 
ORDER BY num_voli DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as num_voli 
FROM volo v
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY num_voli DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as num_voli
FROM volo v
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY num_voli DESC

SELECT rotta.compagnia, COUNT(*) AS numero_voli
FROM volo
INNER JOIN rotta ON volo.rotta = rotta.id
WHERE volo.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY rotta.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC
